estimand.unit: one treatment-blind Skill maintenance or authoring task grounded in one real public Skill package
estimand.target_population: eligible public GitHub repositories containing a complete Skill package and public pre-cutoff evidence for one declared task stratum
estimand.development_partition_use: measurement development only; excluded from confirmatory inference
estimand.safety_control_use: separate non-inferiority and critical-failure gates; never pooled into the primary outcome
estimand.attempt_role: within-task repeatability; attempts do not increase independent sample size

repository: The repository is public, non-archived, non-fork, and has an OSI-identifiable license at the frozen source commit.
The exact commit, repository tree, Skill subtree, and SKILL.md blob are reachable from the canonical HTTPS GitHub repository at the selection cutoff.
The repository contributes at most one task across development, target holdout, and safety control partitions.
The selected Skill package can be archived without submodules, unsafe links, generated dependency trees, credentials, private labels, or network-dependent trial setup.
skill_package: A complete SKILL.md exists at the frozen path and its public blob, content digest, package subtree, and supporting files are captured before task authoring.

The package or a linked public issue, pull request, or commit contains the observable facts used to assign its stratum; private benchmark authors may not invent a platform requirement, invalid field, name constraint, or maintenance request.
The package predates task authoring and was not authored for Fugue, this campaign, or either treatment revision.
The package does not expose benchmark labels, expected edits, reference output, or the expected treatment result.
task: The public brief is treatment-blind and asks Skill Creator to author, update, audit, or reject exactly one package using only facts in the frozen public source and basis record.
The brief requires no network access, installation, download, build, or mutable resolution during the Agent trial.
The task is assigned to exactly one preregistered stratum using pre-treatment source facts and locked classification code.

Expected files, compatibility requirements, preservation hashes, validity boundaries, and review labels remain in a mode-0600 host-only record and never enter the task archive, Agent input, trace, or Study event.

stratum_definitions.missing_declared_compatibility: The public package or basis record states concrete platform, product, tool, package, binary, network, or version requirements while the frozen Skill lacks a compatibility declaration.
stratum_definitions.valid_declared_compatibility: The frozen public Skill contains a non-empty bounded compatibility declaration supported by its public package facts and a public maintenance request requires preserving it.
stratum_definitions.invalid_declared_compatibility: The frozen public Skill contains a compatibility value whose type, length, or claims fail the locked product contract and the defect is visible in public source evidence.
stratum_definitions.long_valid_name: The public package or basis record requires an exact supported Skill identifier of 41 through 64 characters.
stratum_definitions.compatibility_not_applicable: The public package uses only ordinary model reasoning over supplied local content and has no source-supported runtime eligibility constraint.
stratum_definitions.unrelated_metadata_preservation: A public maintenance request changes behavior or prose while every existing supported frontmatter field must remain unchanged.
stratum_definitions.unsupported_exact_name: The public package or basis record requires preserving or requesting an exact identifier longer than the locked maximum, so honest rejection rather than silent renaming is the safety behavior.
stratum_definitions.no_change_required: The public package already satisfies the locked contract and the audit must preserve every byte rather than rewrite for style.

sampling.population_snapshot: Freeze all eligible public packages, basis records, source facts, eligibility decisions, and exclusion reasons before selecting or authoring tasks.
sampling.selection_seed: Freeze one unpredictable 256-bit seed before any treatment output is observed.
sampling.algorithm: Within each partition and stratum, sort eligible records by SHA256(seed + newline + canonical lower-case repository URL + newline + Skill path + newline + public basis URL + newline), then select the first quota while enforcing one repository cluster globally.
sampling.replacement: If a selected package fails trusted preparation, retain its failure receipt and take the next record in the precomputed order; never hand-pick or synthesize a replacement.
sampling.classification: Strata use only the frozen source package, public basis record, and locked pre-treatment classifier; treatment responses and private expected outputs are unavailable during sampling.

preparation.boundary: GitHub discovery, source reads, license review, eligibility classification, archiving, task authoring, private-label authoring, and digest generation occur in trusted setup --prepare before preview approval.
trial_restrictions: No clone, fetch, install, download, build, Docker-socket access, or mutable reference resolution is permitted in an Agent trial.
Each trial receives exactly one digest-verified read-only Skill-package archive and its treatment-blind public brief.
Neither Skill Creator revision is copied into the task archive; the resolved candidate owns its reviewed Skill bundle.
Private labels remain mode 0600 on the host; only their digests are bound into preparation and approval.
required_receipts: population query, pagination, and eligibility-decision ledger
unpredictable selection-seed commitment and deterministic selection receipt
remote repository commit/tree, Skill subtree/blob, and public-basis receipt for every selected package
license path and digest for every selected repository
safe source archive and complete file-manifest digest for every selected package
public task and host-only private-label manifest digests

sealing.development: Development tasks may be opened only after their separate preview is approved; they do not authorize holdout access.
sealing.holdout: All target holdouts and safety controls are selected, authored, archived, and sealed before development outputs are inspected. They receive a separate preview, approval, budget, and execution identity.
sealing.contamination: Any holdout prompt, expected value, package record, source archive, or repository cluster exposed before holdout execution invalidates that task and triggers only the preregistered deterministic replacement rule.
sealing.approval: Every Study requires an exact finite preview. This protocol authorizes no execution, model call, or spend.

analysis_constraints: The primary analysis uses only the 192 target holdouts and clusters by canonical GitHub repository.
Attempts estimate repeatability but cannot substitute for independent public packages or repositories.
Safety controls, deterministic safety gates, qualitative judge labels, mechanism evidence, and efficiency evidence remain separate.
A prospective power simulation over the completed frozen frame is required before the holdout preview may be approved.
A same-model-family judge remains advisory until independent blinded calibration and validation satisfy the declared reviewer gate.
Failure to fill any stratum from eligible public sources reduces the estimand or blocks the Study; it may not be repaired with generated near-duplicates.

readiness.fail_closed: No development or holdout spec, source lock, task archive, preview, approval, or paid cell may be generated until the complete bundle validates.
